name: ecsa_isolation_v1
folds: same six leave-replicate-index-out folds as historical v11
selected_cases: lowest upstream top-1/top-2 probability margin, ties by original row order; same cases in both arms
local_only_readout: select unchanged local-rule challenger if nominated, otherwise upstream top-1
llm_full_pool: all K upstream candidates with identical candidate-card construction
ecsa_filtered_pool: historical local fallback plus at most one evidence-supported challenger
common_fallback: upstream top-1 on abstention, validation/transport failure, or no scheduled call
calibration_gate: disabled identically in both supplementary arms; no arm-specific OOF enable/disable gate
local_readout_scope: local-only adapter on all 660 cases; full ECSA retains historical upstream fallback
retained_behavior_on_no_challenger: singleton upstream fallback; still same scheduled API call opportunity
scope: supplementary controlled budgeted experiment; not a replacement for historical calibrated production run
